agent.voicemail_message: Hi Mike, this is Profit from EstiClose. I'm calling to get you onboarded. Give us a call back at 239-398-9552 or we'll try you again soon.

webhook_pre_call.description: Receives inbound call event, returns contractor data for personalization.

webhook_post_call.description: Captures call outcomes and extracted data after call ends.

custom_functions.name: send_onboarding_form
custom_functions.description: Sends the onboarding form to the contractor via SMS and email. Called during Step 4 of the call flow after verbal terms agreement is obtained.

phone_number.description: Contractor's phone number to send SMS form link

email.description: Contractor's email to send form link

contractor_first_name.description: Contractor's first name for form personalization

custom_functions.speak_during_execution: Sending that over to you right now.
custom_functions.speak_on_failure: Hmm, looks like there was a hiccup sending that. No worries — I'll make sure our team gets it to you at {{email}} right after this call.

custom_functions.name: capture_fallback_phone
custom_functions.description: Stores the contractor's fallback phone number after verbal confirmation. Called during Step 5.

fallback_phone_number.description: The backup phone number provided by the contractor

custom_functions.name: schedule_callback
custom_functions.description: Schedules a callback when the contractor is not available. Called during Step 1 if contractor declines.

preferred_time.description: When the contractor wants to be called back, as stated by them

fallback_phone_number.description: The backup phone number the contractor provided during the call

verbal_terms_agreement.description: Whether the contractor verbally agreed to the terms in Step 3

form_sent.description: Whether the onboarding form was successfully sent during the call

call_outcome.description: The final outcome of the call
